title: CPF Module Schema: Azure Backup Vault Module
description: JSON schema for CPF module 'cpf-azure-prdsvc-dataprotectionbackupvault'. Use this to generate Terraform code that calls the CPF module.

app_id.description: (Required) A descriptive name (abbreviation) for the workload (application) as it is registered in Leanix. The identifier format in Leanix is 'APP-12345', for the purpose of naming resources only 5 number will be used.

blob_backup_policy.type: object({ backup_repeating_time_intervals = optional(list(string), []) operational_default_retention_duration = optional(string, ) vault_default_retention_duration = optional(string, ) time_zone = optional(string, "UTC") retention_rules = optional(list(object({ name = string priority = number duration = optional(string) criteria = list(object({ absolute_criteria = optional(string) days_of_month = optional(list(number)) days_of_week = optional(list(string)) weeks_of_month = optional(list(string)) months_of_year = optional(list(string)) scheduled_backup_times = optional(list(string)) })) life_cycle = optional(list(object({ data_store_type = string duration = string })), []) })), []) })
blob_backup_policy.description: (Optional) Properties configuration for the Blob Storage backup policy. object({ backup_repeating_time_intervals = "(Optional) List of repeating time intervals in ISO 8601 interval format." operational_default_retention_duration = "(Optional) Operational (short-term) default retention duration in ISO 8601 format (e.g. P7D)." vault_default_retention_duration = "(Optional) Vault (long-term) default retention duration in ISO 8601 format (e.g. P30D)." time_zone = "(Optional) Time zone used by the backup schedule." retention_rules = (Optional)list(object({ name = "(Required) Name of the retention rule." priority = "(Required) Numeric priority; lower number = higher priority." duration = "(Required) Default duration applied when life_cycle list not supplied (ISO 8601)." criteria = (Optional)list(object({ absolute_criteria = "(Optional) Possible values include FirstOfDay, FirstOfWeek, FirstOfMonth, etc." days_of_month = "(Optional) List of days of month (1-31)." days_of_week = "(Optional) List of days e.g. Monday, Tuesday, ..." weeks_of_month = "(Optional) List of week indicators e.g. First, Second, Third, Fourth, Last." months_of_year = "(Optional) List of months e.g. January, February, ..." scheduled_backup_times = "(Optional) List of RFC3339 timestamps for scheduled backups." }) life_cycle = list(object({ data_store_type = "(Required) The type of data store. The only possible value is VaultStore." duration = "(Required) The retention duration in ISO 8601 format (e.g., P30D, P6M, P1Y)." })) })) })

cmk_name.description: (optional) Customer managed key name to be used (max 127 chars)

cmk_rotation_policy.type: object({ notify_before_expiry = string time_before_expiry = string time_after_creation = optional(string, null) expire_after = string })
cmk_rotation_policy.description: (Optional) A rotation policy block as defined below object({ notify_before_expiry = "(Optional) Expire a Key Vault Key after given duration as an ISO 8601 duration." time_before_expiry = "(Optional) Rotate automatically at a duration before expiry as an ISO 8601 duration." time_after_creation = "(Optional) Rotate automatically at a duration before expiry as an ISO 8601 duration." expire_after = "(Optional) Expire a Key Vault Key after given duration as an ISO 8601 duration." })

context.description: (Optional) Application context information for the resource(s) (max 10 chars).

create_backup_vault.description: (Optional) Whethere to Create Backup Vaule When Backup Vault is already exists.

create_blob_backup_policy.description: Set to true to enable blob storage backup policy, false otherwise.

create_disk_backup_policy.description: Set to true to enable VM backup policy, false otherwise.

create_postgresqlserver_backup_policy.description: Set to true to enable postgre sqlserver backup policy, false otherwise.

cross_subscription_restore_state.description: (Optional) The state for cross subscription restore settings. Possible value is Disabled.

customer_managed_key.description: (Optional) An customer_managed_key block as defined below object({ key_vault_id = "(Required) The resource ID of the Key Vault where the Key Vault Key resides." cmk_expiration_date = "(Required) Expiration UTC datetime (Y-m-d'T'H:M:S'Z')." })

datastore_type.description: (Optional) Specifies the type of the data store.Possible values are ArchiveStore, SnapshotStore and VaultStore.

disk_backup_policy.type: object({ backup_repeating_time_intervals = list(string) default_retention_duration = string time_zone = string retention_rule = list(object({ name = string duration = string priority = number criteria = object({ absolute_criteria = string }) })) })
disk_backup_policy.description: (Optional) Properties configuration for the Disk Backup Policy. object({ backup_repeating_time_intervals = "(Optional) Specifies a list of repeating time interval. It should follow ISO 8601 repeating time interval." default_retention_duration = "(Optional) Default retention duration in ISO 8601 format." time_zone = "(Optional) Specifies the Time Zone which should be used by the backup schedule." retention_rule = list(object({ name = "(Required) The name which should be used for this Backup Policy Disk. Changing this forces a new Backup Policy Disk to be created." duration = "(Required) Duration of deletion after given timespan. It should follow ISO 8601 duration format. Changing this forces a new Backup Policy Disk to be created." priority = "(Required) Retention Tag priority. Changing this forces a new Backup Policy Disk to be created." criteria = object({ absolute_criteria = "(Optional) Possible values are FirstOfDay and FirstOfWeek. Changing this forces a new Backup Policy Disk to be created." }) })

encryption_state.description: (Optional) The state for encryption settings. Possible values are Disabled, Enabled.

environment.description: (Required) The environment where the resource is deployed. Given as abbreviation to leave more characters to the other naming components (max 3 chars).

existing_backup_vault_id.description: (Optional) The ID of the an existing Backup Vault.

identity.description: (Required) Specifies the type of Managed Service Identity that should be configured on this Data Protection Backup Vault. Only possible value is SystemAssigned.

immutability_state.description: (Optional) The state for immutability settings. Possible values are Disabled, Locked, Unlocked.

instance.description: (Optional) Instance number, if context includes/requires multiple resources of the same type (max 3 int).

key_vault_tags.description: (Optional) Key Vault related tags to be set on key vault child resources.

postgresql_backup_policy.type: object({ backup_repeating_time_intervals = list(string) time_zone = string duration = string data_store_type = string retention_rules = list(object({ name = string priority = number duration = string data_store_type = string criteria = object({ absolute_criteria = optional(string) days_of_week = optional(list(string)) weeks_of_month = optional(list(string)) months_of_year = optional(list(string)) scheduled_backup_times = optional(list(string)) }) })) })
postgresql_backup_policy.description: (Optional) Properties configuration for the PostgreSQL Flexible Server backup policy. object({ backup_repeating_time_intervals = "(Optional) Specifies a list of repeating time interval.It should follow ISO 8601 repeating time interval. Changing this forces a new resource to be created." time_zone = "(Optional) Specifies the Time Zone which should be used by the backup schedule. Changing this forces a new resource to be created." duration = "(Required) The retention duration up to which the backups are to be retained in the data stores. It should follow ISO 8601 duration format. Changing this forces a new resource to be created." data_store_type = "(Required) The type of data store. The only possible value is `VaultStore`. Changing this forces a new resource to be created." retention_rules = list(object({ name = "(Required) Specifies the name of the Backup Policy for the PostgreSQL Flexible Server. Changing this forces a new resource to be created." priority = "(Required) Specifies the priority of the rule. The priority number must be unique for each rule. The lower the priority number, the higher the priority of the rule. Changing this forces a new resource to be created." duration = "(Required) The retention duration up to which the backups are to be retained in the data stores. It should follow ISO 8601 duration format. Changing this forces a new resource to be created." data_store_type = "(Required) The type of data store for this rule. The only possible value is VaultStore. Changing this forces a new resource to be created." criteria = object({ absolute_criteria = "(Optional) Possible values are AllBackup, FirstOfDay, FirstOfWeek, FirstOfMonth and FirstOfYear. These values mean the first successful backup of the day/week/month/year. Changing this forces a new resource to be created." days_of_week = "(Optional) Possible values are Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday and Sunday. Changing this forces a new resource to be created." weeks_of_month = "(Optional) Possible values are First, Second, Third, Fourth and Last. Changing this forces a new resource to be created." months_of_year = "(Optional) Possible values are January, February, March, April, May, June, July, August, September, October, November and December. Changing this forces a new resource to be created." scheduled_backup_times = "(Optional) Specify a list of backup times for backup in the RFC3339 format. Changing this forces a new resource to be created." })

redundancy.description: (Optional) Specifies the backup storage redundancy. Possible values are GeoRedundant and LocallyRedundant.

resource_group_id.description: (Required) The resource ID of the Resource Group in which to create the resource. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

retentiondurationindays.description: (Optional) Soft Delete retention Duration in Days.

soft_delete_state.description: (Optional) The state for soft delete settings. Possible values are AlwaysOn, Off, On.

tags.description: (Optional) Tags to be set on each resource.
